path_conditions: pci_epf_test_write() is invoked from pci_epf_test_cmd_handler(), which is set as the work function of an INIT_DELAYED_WORK() in pci_epf_test_probe(). Workqueue handlers run in process context and are sleepable, so busy-waiting with mdelay() needlessly spins the CPU. The sleeping primitive usleep_range() (or msleep) is the correct idiom. The bug fits the 'delay-gfp' pattern: a busy-wait primitive used where a sleeping equivalent should be used.
